description.fun: Delibird carries food bundled in its sack-like tail and shares it generously with its chicks, other Pokémon and people stranded in the mountains, though, being an omnivore, its gift might be a bug Pokémon. Attack it and it throws the food back at you. With its red-and-white colours and sack of presents it's a nod to Santa Claus, and the Delibird with the biggest tail leads the flock.
description.guide: An Ice- and Flying-type bird Pokémon that carries food in its bag-like tail and shares it, known for the move Present. Its look draws on penguins and Santa Claus. It does not evolve; the Paradox Pokémon Iron Bundle is said to be a future or parallel-world relative.
description.tagline: A Santa-ish penguin that delivers presents from its tail
